invalid.because: primitive is misspelt "stacked_bar"; a consumer dispatching on the property would never match it
primitive is absent, so the node cannot be identified without parsing its class string
class is missing the "qe-dv-stacked-bar" token, so the renderer selector div[class~=qe-dv-stacked-bar] never matches
class repeats the "qe-dv" base token; the directive drops tokens already present when it normalises ":class:", so an un-normalised class string is a defect rather than cosmetic
tone "danger" is outside the closed vocabulary neutral | accent | good | warn | bad
a category carries a typo key "tint" and no "tone"; additionalProperties is false inside categories[]
a segment is missing its required "share", so a consumer would have to recompute a geometry the contract promises
bars[].total is the string "27" rather than a number, so arithmetic against it silently concatenates
a bar has no "label", so its column in the fallback table would have no header
a segment value is negative, which cannot be a share of a composition
the fallback is a grid wrapping the table rather than the table itself: myst-to-tex has no handler for grid, so the whole subtree is dropped from the .tex output while the build still exits 0
children is empty — a primitive whose fallback renders nothing does not implement this contract

every body row marks its row-label cell as a header, the shape this section carried before the family header-row rule: myst-to-tex writes an \hline after any row whose first cell is a header, so the table is ruled after every line, and its long-table path counts leading header rows until one is not a header — with every row a header the count becomes the row count and the body loop skips every row, emitting a repeating running header and no body
row 0 carries no header cells, so the table has no header row: the reader gets no column vocabulary, and myst-to-typst has no head row to repeat
the Total row is marked up as a second header row; only row 0 may be a header row, and a header row after the body is exactly what empties the long-table body
a value cell repeats the segment it renders as properties on the cell, so the same number lives three times instead of twice and the copies can drift; an inner node carries structure and nothing else

the root carries a top-level `label`; `myst-cli`'s embed transform runs `selectAll('[identifier],[label],[html_id]')` over an embedded subtree and deletes all three from every node whose type is not `crossReference`, `cite`, `footnoteDefinition`, `footnoteReference`, `captionNumber` or `link`, so the property works locally and silently disappears the first time the page is embedded elsewhere

a fallback cell holds a `card` node; `myst-to-tex` has no handler for `card` or `grid` and drops the whole subtree from the `.tex` while the build still exits 0, so the family closes a cell's inline content to `text`, `strong`, `emphasis`, `inlineCode` and `link`

the retired `naLabel` is carried on the root: the draft let each block spell a missing value for itself, contract 1.0 spells it one way — `null` in the properties, an em dash in the fallback — so a node still carrying the option sends a consumer looking for a string that means nothing
